## Layout
- `vendor/anaf/ro16931-ubl-1.0.9/`: Schematron source. Entry point `EN16931-CIUS_RO-UBL-validation.sch`.
  The package's old `preprocessed/` files (v1.0.5, v1.0.8) were not used.
- `vendor/anaf/compiled/ro16931-ubl-1.0.9.xslt`: generated by `scripts/build_schematron.py`.
- `vendor/ubl-2.1/xsd/`: `maindoc/` Invoice and CreditNote plus `common/`.
- `vendor/iso-schematron/`: ISO Schematron compiler XSLT from
  https://github.com/Schematron/schematron (MIT license), used only to compile the rules.
- `vendor/en16931-1.3.16/`: precompiled EN 16931 XSLT, not used at runtime.

## Open question
We could not check whether ANAF has published a CIUS-RO Schematron newer than 1.0.9.
